div.div: Under the Hood: What Frameworks Do When You’re Not Looking

switch.text: Under the Hood: What Frameworks Do When You’re Not Looking

div.div: Six sessions. Four languages. One Coffee Shop.

switch.text: Six sessions. Four languages. One Coffee Shop.

div.div: Java (Spring Boot) | Python (FastAPI) | TypeScript (NestJS) | Go (Gin / stdlib)

switch.text: Java (Spring Boot) | Python (FastAPI) | TypeScript (NestJS) | Go (Gin / stdlib)

div.div: Domain: Coffee Shop (Orders, Menu, Kitchen, Notifications)

switch.text: Domain: Coffee Shop (Orders, Menu, Kitchen, Notifications)

div.div: Foundations

Session 1
The IoC Flip

Library vs Framework.
Hollywood Principle: “Don’t call us, we’ll call you.”
Key insight:Control is the only difference.

text.tspan: Hollywood Principle: “Don’t call us, we’ll call you.”
Key insight: Control is the only difference.

div.div:
Session 2
Dependency Injection

IoC applied to wiring.
Constructor vs field injection.
Hands-on:Build a DI container from scratch.

text.tspan: Hands-on: Build a DI container from scratch.

div.div: Framework Internals

Session 3
Who Owns the Main Loop?

Framework lifecycle and request flow.
Servlet containers, ASGI, middleware.
Hands-on:Trace one request end to end.

text.tspan: Hands-on: Trace one request end to end.

div.div:
Session 4
Proxy Pattern & AOP

The magic behind @Transactional, @Cacheable.
Proxies, decorators, middleware are one idea.
Hands-on:Add observability, zero code changes.

text.tspan: Proxies, decorators, middleware are one idea.
Hands-on: Add observability, zero code changes.

div.div: Advanced

Session 5
Chaos Engineering

Breaking things so your users don’t have to.
DI lets you swap failable deps. Proxies trace failures.
Hands-on:Netflix Chaos Monkey, your scale.

text.tspan: Breaking things so your users don’t have to.
DI lets you swap failable deps. Proxies trace
Hands-on: Netflix Chaos Monkey, your scale.

div.div:
Session 6
Putting It All Together

Testing the invisible: security, auth, logging.
All patterns combined in one project.
Outcome:Patterns you drop into any codebase.

text.tspan: Testing the invisible: security, auth, logging.
All patterns combined in one project.
Outcome: Patterns you drop into any codebase.

Format:~1 hour each (talk + hands-on). Each session stands alone.
